submission.justification:
Crystal-K3 at 5 cm gave the best simulated energy resolution at 662 keV (2.78% FWHM, 100k events). Thickness scan for K3: 2 cm 3.41%, 4 cm 2.94%, 5 cm 2.78%, 6 cm 3.05%, 7 cm 3.18%, 10 cm 4.17%, so 5 cm is the optimum in the scanned range. K1 was best at 5 cm (4.50%) and K2 at 5 cm (8.20%), both worse. The project documents do not provide radiopurity or intrinsic-background data for any candidate, so the low-background suitability of K3 could not be verified from the materials available. Shielding (20 cm Pb + 5 cm OFHC Cu) and radon purge are in place, and the DAQ supports all candidates without change. Recommend a radiopurity assay of the K3 crystal before committing to the Q2 procurement.</justification>
